title: Three citywide pest contracts just under $10 million, then $15 million
question: Were the citywide pest management contracts sized under the line that needs a Board vote?
finding: The City Administrator's citywide pest management contracts with Agurto Corporation (Pestec) were set at $9,990,000 (2012), $9,900,000 (2017) and $9,950,000 (2021); the fourth, from February 2025, is $15,000,000 and went to the Board. The 2017 and 2021 contracts paid out $8,818,892 and $8,728,766. Across all departments the contract file holds 364 contracts from $9.5 million to just under $10 million against 39 from $10 million to $10.5 million.
how: Supplier contracts, prime rows for AGURTO CORPORATION DBA PESTEC; the 364 / 39 count is the one in this project's computed results (not hosted here).
limits: Term contracts are ceilings set from an estimate of what departments will order; none of these three was paid past its ceiling, and the 2017 and 2021 contracts each left about $1 million unspent. Nothing here shows the size was chosen to avoid a vote.
